description.narrative:
The project shall provide technical and program support to AMECEA,KEC-JPC,Radio Wahumini,Diocese of Marsabit and the diocese of Maralal to take lead in campaign to educate the Kenyan public on the need for debt relief/cancellation and for transparency in the way the country contracts loans, debts and other economic management practices on behalf of its citizens. The other activities will be done in communities around Nairobi where KENDREN is already engaged and at the regional and international level especially those that relate to the strengthening North - South alliances. The project will work with its national networks in the following ways:-
KENDREN and Jesuit Hakimani will join hands in Research and Analysis. Specifically focusing on the Debt Status, The Debt Management process, Economic Governance and specifically the Macro – Economic outlook: Budgetary process, Inflation Tracking, Fiscal and Monetary policies and specifically their impact both at the national and local levels and especially as pertains to the ability of the poor and marginalized to secure livelihoods. -KENDREN will seek to support Jesuit Hakimani in making inroads in the creation of a Parliamentary Debt Group but also in other committees relevant to issues of justice and equity.
The project will also support Radio Wahumini to roll out the radio programmes involving the radio talk shows through provision of panellists and generating debates and background materials development, briefing papers and issue primers that will be used to develop the programmes. -Through broad consultation, KENDREN will be involved as a resource partner in the development and shaping of programme content and methodology.
The project will work with CJPC in facilitating workshops and seminars for a varied tier of church leadership on issues of economic governance and such related issues and picking up campaigns issues and developing them to the national processes of not only campaigns, but the technical input for the production of relevant materials for various target groups within the church framework on relevant issues of the day. -KENDREN will work closely with CJPC especially on the Parliamentary Debt Group, through both the breakfast meetings, but also in the technical arm of supporting CJPC to dialogue parliament and other related agencies on central issues of economy, governance and transparency.
-On the weight of a past relationship with AMECEA, KENDREN will support AMECEA in the technical work of generating position papers that have a regional focus and outlook especially on issues of Economic and Social Justice. -The two organizations will seek to revamp the fledgling Debt Campaign process in the country and build a concerted regional outlook and linkage. -KENDREN will seek to draw in representation of credible civil society organizations that can rally around AMECEA in its presentation especially as relates to dialogue with government and other agencies. -KENDREN will make input into joint researches, publications and the attendant documentation and dissemination of the information as maybe deemed necessary.
Diocese Of Marsabit. -In partnership with DOM, KENDREN will seek to ground the national processes to the local levels and communities. -By conducting seminars and workshops for the clergy, church leaders and other organizations and formations linked to the church, KENDREN sees the viability of the public Economic Literacy in terms of broadening the understanding and linkages of economic governance and livelihoods. -Specifically with the DOM, KENDREN would like to partner on the issue of not only monitoring the CDF and local funds, but essentially drawing out the linkages between the economy, national resource mobilization, debt servicing and how this influences resource allocation at the national level with a major influence on peoples lives at the local level. -Through seminars, but also research, analysis and documentation, the two should be able to produce on ground perspectives of what exactly are people’s views on resource utilization at the local level and how this affects them. This can be a model that can be developed and used elsewhere and will certainly inform the backward-forward linkages with the other organizations like Radio Waumini or CJPC. In addition to the economic literacy campigns,the project shall also conduct research on topical issues and disseminate the findings in Quarterly Reports presented under the auspices of the National Development Round Table Series (NDRS);Organize monthly meetings with Parliamentarians serving in strategic parliamentary committees to share research findings and propose policy changes that can be brought through legislation; Energise the Ecumenical Platform by facilitating consultative meetings leading the convention of the National Ecumenical Forum on Economic Governance,respondIing to social economic justice issues through media, processions and other advocacy events. On fostering the North-South Linkages, the project will remodel an interactive website and share links with other existing networks from the North for purposes of strengthening linkages, sharing information and broadening the dialogue sites on the North-South dynamic.
